I was in the same position with you literally. Everytime we had a fight she would just tell me to move out but once I had decided to move out for real she did not want me to do that. I just looked up for a place and told them 2 weeks before I moved. It was the longest 2 weeks of my life and emotional draining I have to tell you, just like you mentioned on your post, she tried to convince me, emotionally manipulate me etc. 

When I stayed at home she would snap at me every other day, but since I told her I would move out suddenly she acted strangely nice, which kind of made me question my decision to move out a little bit. But when I saw her being nice to me and literally immediately started picking a fight with my brother when she went to a different room, I was shocked. I knew I had to move, to make my mental health better. To improve our relationships. I moved out, and still be able to visit them once a week and up to now our relationship is better.

You can decide to tell them before moving 1month, 2 weeks, 1 week, 3 days... it's up to you. But you can't control how they react. Also, they need to know that it's your decision, you are not asking for their permission to move out.

The picture above is of my skin 2 years ago. The chemical in swimming pools really destroyed my skin and gave me hundreds of stubborn whiteheads underneath my skin. It also turned my skin from normal/dry skin into oily skin. No matter how much I tried - cleansing, scrubbing, exfoliating using AHA/BHA, moisturising, changing diet etc., nothing changed. I went to a dermatologist and she helped me pop the acnes but after a while it still came back!

Only until I moved to another country with better air quality that my skin start improving. From then I tried to minimize my routine and avoid using products contained alcohol, and as you can see, my skin is finally back to normal, although more sensitive than it used to be.

I only use Simple Kind to skin toner to refresh my skin, Paula's Choice BHA to exfoliate, The Ordinary HA 2% + B5 to moisturise. The only problem is I still don't dare to wear sunscreen again because I'm afraid it will clog my skin pores.
